President Donald Trump‘s campaign cost almost $398 million, which was considerably lower than candidate Hillary Clinton‘s total of more than $768 million.
But Trump was Trump, and thus a constant focus of media attention.
According to mediaQuant, Inc., from July 2015 through October 2016 Trump received free media worth more than $5.9 billion.
Clinton received less than half that figure, a little under $2.8 billion.
That helped negate the fact that Clinton and her supporters massively outspent Trump and his.

Clinton outpaced Trump in campaign committee spending as well as party support; and her outside spending firepower was especially impressive, as single-candidate groups backing Clinton spent more than triple the amount that those in favor of Trump spent.
